title: Fyre Festival: What Investors Were Promised vs. What Was Real

lines.say: Fyre Festival was announced in December two thousand sixteen. Two weekends in the Bahamas.
lines.show: Fyre Festival was announced in December 2016. Two weekends in the Bahamas.

lines.say: Investors were told Fyre had acquired land there worth about eight million dollars. It never owned any.
lines.show: Investors were told Fyre had acquired land there worth about $8 million. It never owned any.

lines.say: Some were promised payouts from event cancellation insurance. No such policy had been executed.
Others were told top musicians would perform. No such agreements were ever reached.
On Exuma, in late April two thousand seventeen, the promised luxury villas and gourmet meals were tents and prepackaged meals. The festival was canceled.
lines.show: On Exuma, in late April 2017, the promised luxury villas and gourmet meals were tents and prepackaged meals. The festival was canceled.

scene.src: Gov't sentencing memo, S.D.N.Y., Oct 3, 2018 · WPLG / KSAT, Apr 28, 2017

lines.say: Prosecutors said at least eighty investors lost more than twenty-four million dollars.
lines.show: Prosecutors said at least 80 investors lost more than $24 million.

lines.say: Real trials. Real evidence. The verdict.
